title: A twilight telescope demonstration

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Welcome to the Westbank observatory. While there is still daylight, we'll use the small telescope to show you how to bring a distant object into focus. You'll be looking at the clock tower, not at the sky. Once the first stars are visible, we'll move to the large telescope on the upper platform. Please don't take pictures from the stairs. There's a marked spot at the top where you can stop without blocking people behind you.
turns.zh: 歡迎來到 Westbank 天文台。天還亮的時候，我們會用小望遠鏡示範如何對焦遠方的物體。大家看的會是鐘樓，不是天空。等第一批星星看得見，我們就移到上層平台的大望遠鏡。請不要在樓梯上拍照。樓梯上方有一處標示好的位置，可以停下來而不堵住後面的人。
